lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: We should keep moving. East. The Depot's that way. Everything's east of something.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: And every dark lamp you light is one less for the Foreman to count.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The Depot's past Main Street. Keep going east.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: In a fight, Help is slow but you make a friend. Hustle is fast but... you don't.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: You helped the Un-Baker count. Nobody helps the Un-Baker count.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The front door's for workers with cards. We use the side door. I know a trick.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Curfew's on the square. Through the big door on the right.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The square's through the big door.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: And don't wind anything you find in the lost-and-found! I mean it!

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: That watch. In a fight, if something's about to hit you, press {rewind}. Don't ask me how I know.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Curfew's slow. Watch the notes when it sings. They fall in an order.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The Un-Baker. The Window Washer. The Puddle Keeper. All of them.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: I lit the way for you. Every lamp.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: I am here not just because of us.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: I'm here because this isn't just me.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: You will kill them all, won't you?

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: All their hopes...

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: All of their dreams...

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: That's why I fight.
You put the flashlight down on the cobbles.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: ...why?

lines.speaker: tadzio
lines.text: The Un-Baker. The Window Washer. The Puddle Keeper. The Jar Keeper. No Job.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: You remember them.

lines.speaker: tadzio
lines.text: I'm sorry, Wick.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Sorry doesn't bring them back.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: You don't get my light anymore!

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: I thought you were my friend.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Every lamp we lit... was it just so you could see them?

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Please. Just go home.
Wick's flame flickers blue.
Hot wax drips onto the cobbles.
The square gets a little darker.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Ow! That's... that's what you did to them.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: I'm not scared of you!

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: I'm... a little scared of you.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: My flame is so small now...

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: ...I believe you. I don't want to. But I do.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: You... let me go?
